Name: JP's Debris Is In The Air - Ambient Lights
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u]DIITA - Ambient Lights[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]An orange sunrise is breaking![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][b][i]This mod changes the colors of the weather both outdoors and indoors, displaying new shades depending on the time of day and the current season. 
Shades of orange in spring, yellowish in summer, reddish in fall, and violet in winter. [/i][/b][/size]


[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]With GMCM, you can configure the mod in various ways:[/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Choose whether the lighting is for indoor, outdoor, or both. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]A subtle shift in colors as the days of the month go by. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]The intensity and/or brightness of the lighting. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Nights that are more or less dark, or just total darkness![/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=4]It's just a visual mod, nothing more. It doesn't affect gameplay unless you set the darkness level very high, in which case you'll have to use lamps and torches or you won't be able to see a thing![/size][/color][/i][/b]


[b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Time-lapse demonstration of the seasons:[/size][/color][/b]

[b][i][size=4]Spring:[/size][/i][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRq6yLj4/Ambient1.gif[/img][/font]

[font=Georgia][b][i][size=4]Summer:[/size][/i][/b]
﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/XvQyrhKL/Ambient1-1.gif[/img]

[b][i][size=4]Autumn:[/size][/i][/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRzk3ZDk/Ambient1-2.gif[/img]

[b][i][size=4]Winter:[/size][/i][/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RZ1tBqWx/Ambient1-3.gif[/img]



[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]﻿And that's it, a few new colors to give the game a fresher feel as time goes by. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
